notes: OAuth; users sign in to their MagicInterview account through the client authorization flow.
Client entries describe OAuth-enabled MCP compatibility, not marketplace approval or completed end-to-end client tests. Interactive MCP App rendering depends on host support.

The tool count covers seven assistant-visible tools on the default compact endpoint. The two app-private helpers magicinterview_app_read and magicinterview_app_write are excluded. The directory endpoint exposes individual operations instead. Historical unprefixed names remain callable compatibility aliases and are not separately advertised.
The public server card and maintained server source advertise these capabilities; authenticated workflow testing is not established by this metadata.
